page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top, page number at top right. Main text: opening lines at full width, then a bracketed litany list in the centre column with a left-margin label "Sancta Maria." and a right-margin bracket with "ora pro nobis." Below the list a catchword-like "Humi-" at the right, which is a line-end catchword.

main_text.p: Fili redemtor mundi Deus, Mariæ nobilis fœcundator, miserere nobis.
Spiritus Sancte Deus, Mariæ mirabilis obumbrator, miserere nobis.
Sancta Trinitas, unus Deus, quæ Mariam glorificas, miserere nobis.
main_text.l: In cœlis glorificata, ora pro nobis.
Quæ Dominum in tuis visceribus habuisti,

page.notes: Left margin label "Sancta Maria." beside the list; right margin bracket with "ora pro nobis." Some words in the list are partly obscured by show-through and stains; "genetosa", "Rosa veris", "pulcherrima" and "exaltas" read with some doubt.
